notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.content:
This game is fully functional on steam Deck, and works great with the built-in controls and display.

[list]
[*] All functionality is accessible when using the default controller configration
[*] In-game interface text is legible on Steam Deck
[*] This game's default graphics configuration performs well on Steam Deck
[/list]

tags.feature: - All functionality is accessible when using the default controller configration
